designationHistory.indexText: Tallahatchie National Wildlife Refuge in northern Mississippi was established in March 1991 under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act and the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act, largely from former Farmers Home Administration lands.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act; Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act
